name: God-Pharaoh's Gift
oracle_text: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may exile a creature card from your graveyard. If you do, create a token that's a copy of that card, except it's a 4/4 black Zombie. It gains haste until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: If you do, create a token that's a copy of that card, except it's a 4/4 black Zombie.

needs.what: a copy_permanent `except_` key that REPLACES the copy's subtypes (e.g. `subtypes: ["Zombie"]`), so the token is a Zombie instead of its other creature types (205.1a; Gatherer ruling: "The token is a Zombie instead of its other creature types"), keeping its card types and mana cost
needs.why_existing_wont_do: copy_permanent's except_ (applied in characteristics._compute via copy_overrides) supports power, toughness, colors, add_subtypes, types, add_types, add_supertypes, remove_supertypes and no_mana_cost. add_subtypes is eternalize's additive shape ("Zombie Snake Wizard"), which would leave the copied creature types on the token; `types` replaces card types only. The rest of the card (begin_combat trigger, may + exile with `as`, copy_permanent from exile, grant_keyword haste on the token binding) is expressible.
